as_told.title: Shuruppak as oldest city sealed by the flood

plain: A researcher named Matt, on Jesse Michels's podcast, talks about Shuruppak, an ancient city in what is now Iraq. Citing a 1931 dig report from the Penn Museum, the University of Pennsylvania's archaeology museum, he says a layer of flood mud about four feet thick sits right on top of the city, which he calls one of the oldest on Earth, sealed and buried by the flood. He tells it as evidence that a great flood of the kind in ancient stories really struck.
